lines.E: Another hunter. Try not to die before you pay me.
lines.D: D-rank. Your sword still looks like it's apologising. Bring it here.
lines.C: Heard you picked a Path. Good. Indecision rusts.
lines.B: Lord's hearts make the best steel. Don't tell the Healer I said that.
lines.A: People ask me if I forged your gear. I say yes. Don't correct me.
lines.S: I'm putting your name on the wall. Don't let it go to your head. Okay, a little.
lines.SOVEREIGN: I made you a sword. It's not for fighting. It's for hanging over a fireplace. Yours.
